0.5.1:
## Improved

- Folder suggestions show compact check and cross buttons with tooltips, and the full folder name is always visible.
- Users who finished onboarding before see the Connect your AI assistant step once.

## Fixed

- Connecting Claude Desktop in the installed app no longer shows Repair needed or fails with Something went wrong.
- The assistant connection uses the bundled Node, so it works whatever Node is installed.
0.5.0:
## New

- **Search across all your meetings.** Find what was said in any meeting, and jump straight to the moment in the transcript. Indexing runs quietly in the background.
- **Suggested decisions and action items.** The Summary tab now proposes decisions and action items from the conversation. Accept the ones you want, dismiss the rest.
- **Folder suggestions.** Unfiled meetings get a suggested folder you can accept with one click. You can also ask for one any time with **Suggest folder** in the meeting menu.
- **Search & insights model.** A new model powers search and suggestions. It is part of the download dialog and has its own card, with real download status, under Settings > Advanced.
- **Connect your AI assistant.** A new onboarding step helps you connect Claude and ChatGPT-compatible assistants, now with their official logos.
- **What's new.** The update banner has an (i) button with the release notes, and a What's new dialog appears once after you update.
- **Framna theme.** A new Theme section in Settings holds the theme picker.
- **Right-click menu.** Right-click a meeting in the sidebar to open its menu.

## Improved

- Assistant settings show placeholders while detecting, and remind you to restart your assistant after connecting or disconnecting.
- Softer borders in light and dark mode.
- Status chips and speaker colors are easier to read in both modes.
- Buttons use a cleaner outline style.
- Better handling of a missing assistant bundle: Meeting Noter repairs it when you connect.

## Fixed

- Tooltips no longer fly in from the corner, and header icon tooltips open below after a short delay.
- Long speaker names no longer overlap transcript text.
- The meeting menu stays open after a right-click.
- Suggesting a folder without the search model now explains what is missing instead of saying no folder matched.
- The release notes dialog falls back to the release page when notes can't be loaded.
- The search model size is shown in correct MB.
